notes.title: DarkSwitch is coming to the PC Gaming Show 2025!
notes.content:
We’re now ready to announce that DarkSwitch will be featured during this year’s PC Gaming Show 2025, one of the most prestigious showcases for upcoming PC titles! 
 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45607128/085f11bf864d48691532b3eaf0eccd12766558b2.png"]
🗓️ Mark your calendars and set your alarms!
📺 Watch it live here: 


[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YXC7hf6PBTE"][/dynamiclink]This is a significant moment for our entire team at Cyber Temple Games and for everyone who has been following the development of Dark Switch. We’ll be unveiling exclusive, specially crafted for the show content — a first-ever glimpse at something very special we’ve been keeping under wraps.

Whether you're here for the vertical city-building, the moral narrative choices, or the thrill of exploring the dreadful fog, be with us and watch the PC Gaming Show stream!

—
Follow us, wishlist the game, and stay tuned — we’re just getting started!
Join our Discord for more news: https://discord.gg/SaF7VUZfNN
